textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Taking Charge of Waste · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: We make a lot of waste in our everyday activities. We throw away old clothes, tins, bottles, paper, vegetable and fruit peels, plastic wrappers, pencil shavings, old batteries and much more.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: We make a lot of waste in our everyday activities. We throw away old clothes, tins, bottles, paper, vegetable and fruit peels, plastic wrappers, pencil shavings, old batteries and much more.
beats.speakEn: We make a lot of waste in our everyday activities. We throw away old clothes, tins, bottles, paper, vegetable and fruit peels, plastic wrappers, pencil shavings, old batteries and much more.

beats.en: Trash lying on the roadside can harm animals, because cows and other animals can die by eating plastic mixed with food. Some people burn plastic, which gives out harmful gases.
beats.speakEn: Trash lying on the roadside can harm animals, because cows and other animals can die by eating plastic mixed with food. Some people burn plastic, which gives out harmful gases.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Taking Charge of Waste · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The first rule is to REDUCE the amount of waste we make. Many people avoid food and drinks packed in wrappers or plastic bottles, and carry cloth bags instead of plastic bags.

beats.en: The first rule is to REDUCE the amount of waste we make. Many people avoid food and drinks packed in wrappers or plastic bottles, and carry cloth bags instead of plastic bags.
beats.speakEn: The first rule is to REDUCE the amount of waste we make. Many people avoid food and drinks packed in wrappers or plastic bottles, and carry cloth bags instead of plastic bags.

beats.en: The second rule is to REUSE things instead of throwing them away. Our grandparents made quilts and bags from old sarees and clothes, and gave old clothes to those in need.
beats.speakEn: The second rule is to REUSE things instead of throwing them away. Our grandparents made quilts and bags from old sarees and clothes, and gave old clothes to those in need.

type: The first rule is to REDUCE the amount of waste we make.
The second rule is to REUSE things instead of throwing them away.
